content:
Overview

Bloomington is a city in IN with a population of 85,000. College town with Indiana University, a vibrant arts scene, and nearby lake recreation. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 24.9.
